message.content: I am what leaves silence and enters you. I move as breath, strike as sound, gather into meaning, break into laughter, prayer, warning, song. I can wound without touch and heal without hands. I am born in mouths, but I outlive them in memory, echo, record, and rumor. I bridge one mind to another, or fail gloriously trying. I am stammer and sermon, whisper and verdict, flirtation and farewell. Before writing pinned me down, I flew. Even now, I live fullest in air, in timing, in tremor, in the human voice risking itself.
